description: This file defines classes and structures related to building and verifying certificate paths in a PKI context, including CertPathBuilder, CertPathBuilderResultPath, and CertPathBuilderDelegate, with functions for path validation, error handling, and path iteration.

classes.name: CertPathBuilderDelegateData
classes.description: Base class for custom data that can be attached to certificate paths during path building.

classes.name: CertPathBuilderResultPath
classes.description: Represents a candidate certificate path, indicating validity, trust, associated errors, and related data.

classes.name: CertPathBuilderDelegate
classes.description: Interface controlling policies for certificate verification and path building, including path validation checks and deadline management.

classes.name: CertPathBuilder
classes.description: Main class for building and verifying certificate paths to trust anchors, supporting path iteration, error reporting, and path selection.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Structure encapsulating the overall result of a path building attempt, including paths tried, best path, errors, and limits exceeded.

methods.name: CheckPathAfterVerification
methods.description: Called after RFC 5280 verification to allow delegate to reject or accept candidate paths.

methods.name: IsDeadlineExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the path building process should be terminated due to deadline expiry.

methods.name: CertPathBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing path builder with target cert, trust store, delegate, and verification parameters.

methods.name: AddCertIssuerSource
methods.description: Adds an issuer source for intermediate certificates during path building.

methods.name: SetIterationLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of path iteration attempts.

methods.name: SetDepthLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum depth of certificate chains.

methods.name: SetExploreAllPaths
methods.description: Configures whether to explore all possible paths or stop at the first valid one.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the certificate path verification process.
